newsitem.title: USA: Hartford stock up after IPO announcement.
newsitem.headline: Hartford stock up after IPO announcement.

text.p: Shares in diversified insurer ITT Hartford Group Inc surged by about five percent on Monday morning, shortly after the company announced it will spin off a 20 percent stake in its life insurance business.

Some industry analysts had been expecting The Hartford to spin off its life subsidiary for some time. "An offering of 20 percent of the life company could raise as much as $800 million, which could be used to accelerate the company's international expansion and/or take advantage of domestic consolidation activities," analyst Weston Hicks of Bernstein Research wrote in a report in November 1996.
At 1042 EST/1542 GMT, shares in The Hartford were up 3-3/4 to 79 on volume of 123,500 shares.
